title: PDU session reactivation result error cause

entities.name: PDU session reactivation result error cause
entities.description: Indicates the cause of failure to re-establish user-plane resources for PDU sessions when the PDU session reactivation result IE is included and there are PDU sessions that cannot be reactivated.

entities.name: PDU session reactivation result
entities.description: Contains the result of PDU session reactivation attempts.

entities.name: PDU sessions with failed user-plane re-establishment
entities.description: Condition where one or more PDU sessions cannot have their user-plane resources re-established during reactivation.

relations.description: The error cause IE is included only if the PDU session reactivation result IE is present.
The error cause IE is included only if there are PDU sessions for which user-plane resources cannot be re-established.
The error cause IE is defined as part of the PDU session reactivation result IE context.
